production_readiness_gate.gate_question: Is Attestor sufficiently implemented, internally consistent, validated, and operationally controlled to create its first real canonical Attestation and Trust Statement?
production_readiness_gate.scope: Authorization to begin the first controlled Attestor production operation. This is not production proof and does not itself create, allocate, activate, validate, conform, or publish a production ATT/TRST object.

criteria.criterion: Canonical ATT/TRST schemas and executable validation rules established
evidence_basis: Steps 3-12: machine contract, canonical VAL-* accounting, executable validator v0.5
Representative ATT and TRST each achieved aggregate Validation Result valid

criteria.criterion: Machine Validation and governed Review are explicitly separated
evidence_basis: Steps 11-14: Review-bound rules remain non-machine adjudications
Governed Review Record Contract established

criteria.criterion: Conformance is executable without collapsing Validation into Conformance
evidence_basis: Steps 13-14: executable conformance evaluator
VALID + missing Review => UNDETERMINED; VALID + satisfied required Review => CONFORMANT

criteria.criterion: Representative artifacts cannot be promoted or relabeled as production proof
evidence_basis: Step 15 Production Alignment explicitly prohibits representative-to-production relabeling

criteria.criterion: Production identifier allocation is controlled and deferred until Gate PASS / operation start
evidence_basis: Identifier architecture established
Step 15-16 preserve production identifier boundary
ATT-2026-0001 and TRST-2026-0001 remained unallocated through Gate evaluation

criteria.criterion: Real governed matter can be selected and bounded without pre-allocating ATT/TRST identity
evidence_basis: Production methodology separates readiness approval from matter selection and canonical object creation
Production Run Manifest supports governed matter before ATT/TRST allocation

criteria.criterion: Production Eligibility can be separately recorded
evidence_basis: Eligibility architecture established
Step 16 Eligibility Record Template created

criteria.criterion: Evaluation Basis can be separately recorded and traced
evidence_basis: Evaluation architecture established
Step 16 Evaluation Basis Template created

criteria.criterion: Rule-constrained Evaluation can be preserved as a governed record distinct from TRST
evidence_basis: Evaluation architecture established
Step 16 Evaluation Record Template created

criteria.criterion: Source state at evaluation can be preserved
evidence_basis: Provenance architecture establishes Source State at Evaluation distinction
Execution Context architecture and production evidence package provide preservation mechanism

criteria.criterion: Production execution-context assertions require attributable evidence
evidence_basis: Step 16 Production Execution Context Contract requires evidence references for assertions

criteria.criterion: Lifecycle events can be distinctly recorded
evidence_basis: Lifecycle architecture established
Step 16 Lifecycle Event Record Template created

criteria.criterion: Publication remains a separate authorized decision
evidence_basis: Publication architecture established
Step 16 Publication Decision Record Template created

criteria.criterion: Production operation can be reconstructed from a governed evidence package
evidence_basis: Step 15 Production Run Manifest Template and evidence-package requirements established

criteria.criterion: Failure, incomplete, and undetermined paths do not become success
evidence_basis: Executable Validation exercised invalid/incomplete/error paths
Executable Conformance exercised UNDETERMINED path

criteria.criterion: No architecture-critical unresolved implementation blocker remains before first production identity allocation
evidence_basis: Step 16 closed six identified preparation-artifact gaps
Gate preparation assessment reported zero blockers

conditions: The first operation must use real governed matter and actual attributable evidence.
Representative ATT/TRST objects, reports, Review records, and Conformance records must not be reused or relabeled as production evidence.
Canonical production identifiers are allocated only during the governed production operation under identifier controls.
Eligibility, Evaluation Basis, Evaluation, Validation, Review, Conformance where applicable, Lifecycle, and Publication where applicable remain separate governed stages.
Production execution-context assertions must cite attributable evidence.
Any failure, invalid, incomplete, undetermined, or unresolved mandatory condition must stop or govern advancement rather than be treated as success.
Post-operation institutional review is required before declaring Attestor operational proof established.
production_readiness_gate.authorized_next_action: Begin First Production Operation preparation and select/bound the real governed matter. Identifier allocation occurs only at the appropriate canonical creation step.
notes: Gate PASS establishes readiness to execute; it is not evidence that a production operation has occurred.
One successful production path will not establish every possible Attestor profile or edge case.
